values.note: Five primitive sites in one large open field on the south shore, for tent and RV camping, each with a table and fire ring; all five list RV and trailer in the catalog, but no vehicle length is published. Site 1 takes 8 people, sites 2-5 take 16.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233211 ('The campground offers five primitive campsites for tent and RV camping. Each offers tables and campfire rings.'; 'These campsites is located in a large open field on the shores of Cookson Lake'; 'Maximum Number of People: Site 1 (8), Sites 2-5 (16)') + RIDB catalog (equipment RV/TRAILER on all five; no Max Vehicle Length), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Pack in, pack out. recreation.gov lists one pit toilet near one of the sites (no toilet paper); the FS page says 'Restrooms are not available at this site.' Public boat ramp beside site 2.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233211 ('A pit toilet is located near one of the sites, but toilet paper is not provided. Drinking water is NOT present'; notice 'Pack- in, Pack-out policy') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/cookson-lake-campsites ('Restrooms are not available at this site.' values.note: Reservation only ('Walk ins are not allowed'). Run by the Forest Service (Munising Ranger District), not a concessionaire. The site must be occupied the first night and not left unattended over 24 hours.

These sites may be reserved for up to 14 days.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233211 (org FS, is_commercially_managed false; notices 'There is a 14 day stay limit.', 'Campsite must be occupied the first night.', 'Campsite cannot be left unattended for more than 24 hours.'), read 2026-10-25

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/cookson-lake-campsites ('Seasons of Use May 15 - Columbus Day'), read 2026-10-25

note: Primitive campsites in a large open field on the south shore of 35-acre Cookson Lake (two small islands), Hiawatha NF, south of Wetmore: FH-13 11.9 mi to FR 2258, about 2.5 mi to FR 2257 (just before the Indian River bridge), then 1.8 mi to the access road. Swimming; largemouth bass, pike, bluegill and bullhead. No ORVs at the sites or on surrounding roads. Site lengths are not published - ring the Munising Ranger District before bringing a 23-ft rig. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + rates + RIDB catalog + FS page: 5 sites (confirmed) clustered in one open field, listed for tent and RV (no lengths published), no hookups, no drinking water (confirmed), $8 (confirmed, 2026 and 2027), passes accepted (new), reservation only, walk-ins not allowed (fcfs never, 14-night limit, url new), season May 15 - Columbus Day (new). FS-run (Munising RD), no concessionaire. Phone 906-387-2512 matches rec.gov's local number. No forest alert or order touches the campsites or FR 2258/2257. Note's 'forest roads 2258/2254' corrected to 2258/2257 per both pages; field restatements trimmed.
